alt: Covered hall with red roof trusses and skylights above a line of people practising on mats
subject: A wide view of a covered hall with red roof trusses and skylights above a line of practitioners bending on mats.

alt: A line of people in downward-facing dog on mats in front of a painted tree mural
subject: A line of participants holds downward-facing dog on mats along a painted floor in front of a tree mural.

alt: Class folding forward in two rows down a plant-lined hall, daylight through the skylight roof.
subject: Two rows of practitioners fold forward over mats down the length of a plant-lined hall, with daylight entering through the skylight roof behind them.

alt: Students seated on mats in forward bends across a wide open hall with chairs along the wall
subject: Students sit on mats in forward bends across a wide open hall with white chairs along the wall and a light stand at the right.

alt: Practitioners lying still on mats as the teacher sits cross-legged facing them
subject: Practitioners lie motionless on mats while the teacher sits cross-legged facing them, the tree mural and a colour-wheel chart on the wall behind.

alt: Cropped view of a dancer's crimson drape and bare feet in a wide braced stance.
subject: A headless crop of a dancer's torso, crimson drape and bare feet in a wide braced stance on a pale painted floor.

alt: Seen from behind an audience, a projection screen glowing at the far end of a hall
subject: View from behind the seated audience toward a lit projection screen, an arm raised at the right edge.

alt: Driveway beside a long blue metal wall covered in a colourful painted mural.
subject: A driveway running alongside a long blue corrugated wall painted with a large figurative mural, with trees overhead and a parked scooter at the far end.

alt: Empty exhibition hall with framed pictures on a dark wall and a hanging root installation.
subject: An empty exhibition hall with framed pictures on a dark wall, a striped hammock, and a large hanging mass of dried roots under a corrugated roof.

alt: Framed paintings hung on wires along a black gallery wall, with a hammock at one end.
subject: A black gallery wall hung with a row of small framed paintings on ceiling wires, a hammock at the left end and pots on plinths below.

alt: Teacher leaning over a seated participant to adjust his posture while others watch from chairs
subject: A teacher leans over a seated participant to adjust his posture while a woman sits on a mat in front and others watch from plastic chairs.

alt: A bare foot at the end of a mat with blurred figures holding a plank behind
subject: A bare foot rests at the end of a mat in the foreground while blurred figures hold a plank behind.

alt: Teacher standing by a whiteboard of yoga charts while students lie on mats
subject: A teacher stands beside a whiteboard of yoga charts while students lie on their backs on mats in the foreground.

alt: A teacher works with one participant while the rest of the class stands watching
subject: A teacher works with one participant in the middle of the hall while the rest of the class stands watching, with stacked folding chairs and a rope wall behind.

alt: One person adjusts the shoulder of another while a third looks on and students watch from the floor.
subject: Three people stand close together as one adjusts the shoulder of another and a third observes, with two participants seated on mats in the foreground beside a block.

alt: Barefoot teacher walking across a yellow painted floor between rolled mats
subject: A barefoot man in a dark kurta and olive trousers walks across a yellow painted floor between rolled mats; his head is outside the frame.

alt: Three women standing side by side with eyes lowered, plants behind them
subject: Three women stand in a line in profile with their eyes lowered, with more practitioners and a bank of potted plants behind them.

alt: A man from behind, hands on hips, standing before a mirror and stacked bolsters
subject: A man seen from behind stands with hands on hips on a rug, facing a mirror and a stack of round bolsters.

alt: A full class of practitioners holds a low lunge on mats in front of a studio rope wall.
subject: A wide view of a full class on mats across the floor, most in a low lunge, with a rope wall and red ceiling slings behind and a man seated in the foreground.

alt: Man spreading a yellow blanket over a mat as a woman crouches beside him
subject: A man kneels spreading a yellow blanket over a mat while a woman crouches beside him and others stand talking behind near the window.

alt: Close crop of a crimson skirt and anklet-wrapped feet lifted off the ground.
subject: Close crop of a dancer's draped crimson skirt and anklet-wrapped feet caught off the ground, over a blurred green floor.
